answers.core: This would greatly improve the usability of the editor when multiple scenes are opened at once. Currently as-is, if feels this section is lacks a better way to handle a lot of scenes opened at once, since Scene tree do have a search, FileSystem do have a search AND Favorites and scenes tab only have a distraction free mode that will hide Inspector, FileSystem, etc.
answers.workaround: Probably can't be worked around with plugins or a few lines of script.

title: Allow Multiple Rows of Tabs in the Opened Scene Tabs Section
